## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A second one-fascicle parallel rendering of the same Mahāśrīsūtra material treated above in [KR6j0480](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0480) (T1252a). Both renderings are attributed to **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) and bear the identical title, but they differ in textual detail. T1252b reflects the line of transmission in 【大】【大→宋】【大→元】【大→明】 (the principal printed Tripiṭaka witnesses); T1252a reflects an alternate witness in CBETA (likely from a single manuscript or block-printed edition).

**Abstract**

The same Twelve-Names structure as T1252a, with variations in: (a) the transliteration of the Sanskrit names; (b) the Chinese-glossed translations of certain epithets; (c) some details of the rite-explanation. As with most parallel-recension pairs in the Esoteric corpus, both were retained because the Indian recensions diverged enough that one could not stand for the other. Date: Amoghavajra's Chángān activity, 746–774.
